policy: Original quote rates and amounts are preserved; accepted original labour/material splits remain null.
Public labour and supply references are separate, qualified evidence, not an allocation of the quote.
Daily wages, product supply units, sheet areas and project measurement bases are not interchanged without productivity or take-off.
Finished products can contain factory labour; their purchase price is supply-side reference, not a raw-material bill.
Missing values mean unknown, never zero. No arbitrary percentage, midpoint or subtraction residual is called material.
Six holds and two allowances remain unsplit. Draft calculator entries do not alter the estimate or create an accepted quote.

observations.label: Skilled trade daily wage
observations.qualification: General skilled-trade schedule benchmark. Crew composition, worker-days per item/unit and specialist premiums are unknown.

observations.label: General construction helper wage
observations.qualification: Helper daily wage, not a skilled-worker substitute. Productivity and helper count are unknown.

observations.label: Fibre cement wall board options, 8–12 mm
observations.qualification: Material-only alternatives: 8 mm=67; 9 mm=75; 10 mm=85; 12 mm=94 NPR/ft². Not a complete partition, two faces, aluminium frame or fixings.

observations.label: Vinyl laminated gypsum ceiling board, 7 mm
observations.qualification: Board supply benchmark for a named 7 mm variant, not the approved project board or complete ceiling; frames, cutting, fixings and lights excluded.

observations.label: Both-side laminated hybrid board, 18 mm
observations.qualification: One listed WPC/hybrid board option; material face area only. Desk construction, backing, hardware and required board take-off are unknown.

observations.label: Supply and fix 12.5 mm gypsum false ceiling
observations.qualification: Explicit supply-and-fix benchmark. It is not a material-only price and is never moved into the material column.

observations.label: Modular cabinet labour benchmark
observations.qualification: Kitchen-cabinet benchmark; curved cupboards, shoe racks, lockers and project cabinet depth/measurement basis may differ.

observations.label: Modular cabinet with-material package
observations.qualification: With-material package includes labour. Subtracting labour does not prove a pure material price; no residual is classified as material.

observations.label: 18 mm plywood, 8×4 ft sheet options
observations.qualification: Sheet prices, not the cabinet-front rate. Grade differs; cut list, number of faces, laminate, hardware, adhesive and wastage are not included.

observations.label: Wall-mounted split AC installation labour
observations.qualification: Labour for one supported 1/1.5/2-ton wall-mounted unit. Consumables, extra piping, brackets and electrical scope need confirmation; source 1.5 MT remains ambiguous.

observations.label: Ceiling light installation labour
observations.qualification: One ceiling fixture; does not establish wardrobe-light content, new circuits or all wiring in the project.

observations.label: Decorative light installation labour
observations.qualification: Generic decorative fixture only; heavy chandeliers, special supports and new wiring can cost extra.

observations.label: Painting labour, partial scope
observations.qualification: Paint application benchmark; putty, sanding, primer and repairs are not confirmed as part of this labour rate.

observations.label: Standard plastic emulsion supply
observations.qualification: Per litre only. Published two-coat coverage is 40–60 ft²/L; brand, coats, primer, putty and waste remain project choices.

observations.label: Two-coat emulsion paint consumption example
observations.qualification: Derived paint-only envelope: 250÷60 to 800÷40 NPR/ft², using published 40–60 ft²/L for two coats. No wastage, primer or putty included.

observations.label: Marble installation labour
observations.qualification: General floor/slab installation benchmark. Small counters, adhesive, polishing, edges and surface preparation differ.

observations.label: White marble grade alternatives
observations.qualification: Indian to premium white marble alternatives, not the project grade. Range is markedly above the older source; do not replace the quote or average conflicting grades.

observations.label: Smooth wall putty, 40 kg pack
observations.qualification: Manufacturer MRP; currency is unstated. No bag-to-covered-area conversion without consumption and coats.

observations.label: LED strip light
observations.qualification: Driver, channel, cable and fitting excluded. V4 snapshot retrieved 16 October 2026; current stock/price not revalidated.

observations.qualification: Approximate fixture price; wardrobe lights and wiring are not included. V4 snapshot retrieved 16 October 2026; current stock/price not revalidated.
